description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeaveCommentAPI class related to the Leave module of OrangeHRM. It tests functionality such as creating, retrieving, and validating leave comments via the API.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing LeaveCommentAPI functionalities such as create, retrieve, and validation of leave comments within the OrangeHRM Leave API module.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Tests that the LeaveCommentAPI correctly returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new leave comment via the API, including successful creation and response validation.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the leave record is not found during comment creation, expecting a not found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the input rules for creating a leave comment.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all comments for a specific leave request.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests retrieving comments for a non-existent leave record and expects a not found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the input rules for fetching all comments.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete functionality is not implemented and throws the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete operation, which is not implemented and should throw an exception.
